title: frangula sanguinea
intro: Frangula sanguinea, commonly known as Red Alder Buckthorn or Red Rue, is a perennial shrub native to North America, often found growing in wetland areas. Its bark and roots have been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its health benefits, including aiding in the treatment of digestive issues, diarrhea, and constipation. The therapeutic actions of Frangula sanguinea are attributed to its purgative and laxative properties, which work by stimulating the bowel movements and promoting the excretion of waste. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include anthraquinone glycosides, such as aloe-emodin and emodin, as well as other compounds like flavonoids and phenolic acids.
